user_saw: With maxActiveTranscriptBytes set and many tools, byte-triggered compaction ran early and every reply showed the 'continuing with bounded recent context' notice, even right after compaction.
summary: Added transcriptEventChargesContextBytes so that SQLite, actor and memory-actor active-transcript byte counters stop charging `custom` entries (such as the openclaw.system-prompt checkpoint), while those entries keep context eligibility.
reasoning: The accounting rule (sum serialized_bytes over context_eligible=1, where transcriptEventContextEligibility returns 1 for custom entries) and the openclaw.system-prompt checkpoint writer (session-prompt-state.ts) both predate the 2026-09-03 graft; the later actor counters (c9e7c71c0859 #171448, 87ca2c83893c #174274) only copied the existing SQL semantics, so none of them is a regression. This most likely never worked as intended once the byte cap and the tool-bearing checkpoint coexisted, but a path-limited -S search for when maxActiveTranscriptBytes and the latch were introduced timed out, so I could not identify the introducing commit and do not name a cause.
